messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P2 paging — us-west inference p95 elevated to ~1.6s (baseline ~220ms). Affected: hosted inference routes in us-west. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/latency-us-west. Eng oncall paged, please acknowledge.

sam_oncall: ack. looking.

kate_ops: grabbing metrics + checking recent deploys. Deploy-bot shows deploy 1789 rolled ~3m ago.

miguel_runtime: seeing KV eviction spikes coincident with the p95 tail. Evicted_keys/sec jumped and hit-rate dropped. Might be cache churn from prefix caching.

lina_product: quick question — any concrete customer-facing errors or just slowness?

asha_cs: multiple tickets reporting slower responses (not 5xxs). Will track affected accounts.

sam_oncall: immediate plan: 1) check if deploy touched batching/routing; 2) if KV churn, reduce prefix TTL and/or warm caches; 3) scale up pool and route priority customers to dedicated nodes.

kate_ops: rollback candidate: deploy 1789 included a batching window change (continuous_batch_window -> 8ms). Rolling back to 4ms may reduce tail. Starting canary rollback now.

miguel_runtime: running `rctl snapshot-kv --pool us-west-inference` to assess cache health.

kate_ops: canary rollback started ✅

miguel_runtime: KV snapshot: hit rate down ~30% during p95 spikes, eviction spikes align with token-heavy requests.

sam_oncall: Mitigation steps (executing):
  - rollback batching tweak (in progress)
  - scale us-west pool +2 nodes: `rctl scale --pool us-west-inference --replicas +2`
  - temporarily route high-priority customers to dedicated pool via routing policy
Estimated improvement: visible in 10–20m, full recovery 30–45m.

kate_ops: executing scale: `rctl scale --pool us-west-inference --replicas 4` — provisioning nodes.

status-bot: Provision events — 2 nodes provisioning (provider: cloud-az2), ETA ~8m.

lina_product: draft status page / customer message — please review:

```
We are investigating increased request latency for hosted inference in the us-west region. Some customers may see slower responses; requests are succeeding. Our engineers are deploying mitigations (rolling back a recent batch config change and scaling capacity). We expect visible improvement within 10–20 minutes and full recovery within 30–45 minutes. We'll post another update in 30 minutes or sooner.
```

asha_cs: suggestion — add "affected routes" and incident ID link. I'll prepare targeted DMs for flagged customers.

sam_oncall: internal comms snippet for support / SRE copy/paste:

```
SHORT: Investigating increased inference latency in us-west. Mitigations: rollback batching change, scale capacity, reroute priority customers.
IMPACT: Increased p95 latency — requests succeed but are slower. ETA improvement: 10–20m.
ACTION: Watch the status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1789509999
```

kate_ops: canary rollback finished — canary nodes p95 dropped from 1.6s -> 450ms. Rolling the rollback forward to remaining nodes.

miguel_runtime: after rollback + scale, KV hit rate stabilizing. Observed p95 across pool ~380–420ms and trending down.

lina_product: status page updated with the draft message and ETA. Posted update at 1789510300.

asha_cs: customer DM template ready — sending to three customers who reported slowdowns now :email: .

sam_oncall: handing lead to miguel for watch; I'll hand off to morning oncall at 1789513600. miguel, you good to own monitoring and next steps?

miguel_runtime: taking lead for monitoring. Setting alert thresholds: p95 > 800ms for 5m triggers immediate page.

kate_ops: new nodes are active; healthchecks passing.

status-bot: Incident note — mitigation applied (rollback + scale). Status set to "mitigation in progress".

sam_oncall: thanks, team. I'll post a short internal summary for execs in #incidents-briefing and leave watch to miguel. Page me if metrics degrade.

miguel_runtime: acknowledged. Will post follow-up on baseline recovery or if additional action required.

asha_cs: CS has DM'd impacted customers with status link; will follow up when fully recovered.

kate_ops: healthchecks passing across 100% of nodes; closing loop on rollback.

miguel_runtime: p95 steady at ~260ms now — within SLA target. Marking for recovery confirmation.

sam_oncall: incident resolved — moving to post-incident review. Action items: A) add KV eviction telemetry to runbook, B) gate future batching experiments, C) postmortem owner: kate_ops. Postmortem draft ETA: 48h.

status-bot: Incident state: resolved. Final update posted 1789511799. :white_check_mark:
